name: Mack's Hot Orange Snore Mufflers Silicone Putty Ear Plugs (NRR 22) (Pack of 6 Pairs)
description: Mack's® Snore Mufflers™ Silicone Putty Ear Plugs are made of hypo-allergenic, soft, moldable, silicone putty. Just like other Mack's moldable silicone ear plugs, Snore Mufflers mold easily, and comfortably to the unique contours of any ear. Once in place, Snore Mufflers apply no pressure to the ear, and the "cover-the-canal-only" design provides unsurpassed comfort for quality, restful sleep. Mack's Snore Mufflers are highly recommended for sleeping with a snoring spouse, noisy neighbors, and hunting buddies. Snore Mufflers are very helpful in air travel, and many other applications including industrial noise environments up to 107 dB. The Hot Orange color provides for easy compliance checks in the workplace too. Snore Mufflers are sold in a 6 pair pack. A convenient storage/carrying case is included.
